### 1907 - Husserl's Thing and Space (1907)

`husserl-thing-and-space-commentary`

- **introduced** · `zeitlichkeit/ding/001` · *pre-phenomenal temporality*
  The immanent extension and divisibility of perception that survives the reduction is named pre-phenomenal or transcendental temporality and sharply distinguished from the phenomenal temporality attributed to objects.
  `husserl-thing-and-space-commentary#h3-s19-the-temporal-extension-of-the-appearance-pre-empirical-pre-phenomenal-tempor` · § 19 · [§19. The temporal extension of the appearance. Pre-empirical (pre-phenomenal) temporality](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserl-thing-and-space-commentary.html#the-temporal-extension-of-the-appearance-pre-empirical-pre-phenomenal-temporality)
  > This immanent extension is what Husserl calls **pre-phenomenal** or **transcendental temporality**, and he sharply distinguishes it from **phenomenal temporality**, which is the time attributed to objects — the time of things as constituted through the apprehension.

- **introduced** · `zeitlichkeit/ding/002` · *form of intuition*
  Two temporal forms are distinguished in every perception, one reell and one intentional, with the warning that the form of intuition is not the form of the intuited.
  `husserl-thing-and-space-commentary#h3-s19-the-temporal-extension-of-the-appearance-pre-empirical-pre-phenomenal-tempor` · § 19 · [§19. The temporal extension of the appearance. Pre-empirical (pre-phenomenal) temporality](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserl-thing-and-space-commentary.html#the-temporal-extension-of-the-appearance-pre-empirical-pre-phenomenal-temporality)
  > Husserl warns against confusing them: the "form of intuition" (the immanent temporal form of the perceptual appearance) is not the same as the "form of the intuited" (the temporal form of the appearing thing).

- **presupposed** · `zeitlichkeit/ding/003` · *continuous unity*
  The temporal unity of perception is declared primary: phases are dependent moments of an already continuous whole rather than independent pieces later joined by synthesis.
  `husserl-thing-and-space-commentary#h3-s19-the-temporal-extension-of-the-appearance-pre-empirical-pre-phenomenal-tempor` · § 19 · [§19. The temporal extension of the appearance. Pre-empirical (pre-phenomenal) temporality](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserl-thing-and-space-commentary.html#the-temporal-extension-of-the-appearance-pre-empirical-pre-phenomenal-temporality)
  > It is not that discrete perceptual phases first exist independently and are then joined by a subsequent synthesis. Rather, perception is always already a continuous, unbroken unity.

- **presupposed** · `zeitlichkeit/ding/004` · *Now*
  The constitution of temporal position - what distinguishes now from just past, and the perpetual sinking of the Now - is posed as an immense difficulty the lectures defer.
  `husserl-thing-and-space-commentary#h3-s19-the-temporal-extension-of-the-appearance-pre-empirical-pre-phenomenal-tempor` · § 19 · [§19. The temporal extension of the appearance. Pre-empirical (pre-phenomenal) temporality](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserl-thing-and-space-commentary.html#the-temporal-extension-of-the-appearance-pre-empirical-pre-phenomenal-temporality)
  > What accounts for the distinction between "now" and "just past"? What explains the perpetual self-generation of the Now and its perpetual sinking back into the past — the "eternal drama" as Husserl puts it — in which every past itself becomes a *further* past?

- **presupposed** · `zeitlichkeit/ding/005` · *phenomenological temporality*
  Givenness is said to be carried out as a process in phenomenological temporality, the total phenomenon with its kinaesthetic and image components being temporally extended and having a changeable temporal form.
  `husserl-thing-and-space-commentary#h3-s56-the-temporal-structure-of-the-kinaesthetic-sequences` · § 56 · [§56. The temporal structure of the kinaesthetic sequences](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserl-thing-and-space-commentary.html#the-temporal-structure-of-the-kinaesthetic-sequences)
  > But givenness is carried out as a **process in phenomenological temporality**: the total phenomenon, with its K-component and its i-component, is temporally extended.

- **introduced** · `zeitlichkeit/ding/006` · *temporal form*
  The temporal form of the kinaesthetic-image stream is held irrelevant for the appearing object: the same thing stands there whatever the speed or direction of exploration.
  `husserl-thing-and-space-commentary#h3-s56-the-temporal-structure-of-the-kinaesthetic-sequences` · § 56 · [§56. The temporal structure of the kinaesthetic sequences](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserl-thing-and-space-commentary.html#the-temporal-structure-of-the-kinaesthetic-sequences)
  > Whether I explore the thing quickly or slowly, whether I pause longer at one phase or another, whether I reverse and retrace my steps — the same stationary thing continually stands there with unchanged content, extending the fullness of its content in a temporal form that is one and the same: a density homogeneous throughout.

- **revised** · `zeitlichkeit/ding/007` · *duration*
  The irrelevance is qualified: temporality does enter the objectivation as the duration of the unchanged thing, which finds its presentational foothold in the phenomenological temporality of the appearance.
  `husserl-thing-and-space-commentary#h3-s56-the-temporal-structure-of-the-kinaesthetic-sequences` · § 56 · [§56. The temporal structure of the kinaesthetic sequences](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserl-thing-and-space-commentary.html#the-temporal-structure-of-the-kinaesthetic-sequences)
  > In the present case, the temporality has the form of the **duration of the unchanged, stationary thing**. The thing endures; its duration is constituted in the temporal stream of perception.

- **presupposed** · `zeitlichkeit/ding/008` · *temporal object*
  Spatial things are contrasted with temporal objects such as melodies, whose constitution depends essentially on the temporal form of their presentation.
  `husserl-thing-and-space-commentary#h3-s56-the-temporal-structure-of-the-kinaesthetic-sequences` · § 56 · [§56. The temporal structure of the kinaesthetic sequences](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserl-thing-and-space-commentary.html#the-temporal-structure-of-the-kinaesthetic-sequences)
  > the spatial thing is constituted in an appearance-manifold that can be traversed in any direction and at any rate, unlike temporal objects (melodies) whose constitution depends essentially on the temporal form of their presentation

- **presupposed** · `zeitlichkeit/ding/009` · *temporality*

  `husserl-thing-and-space-commentary#h3-s56-the-temporal-structure-of-the-kinaesthetic-sequences` · § 56 · [§56. The temporal structure of the kinaesthetic sequences](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserl-thing-and-space-commentary.html#the-temporal-structure-of-the-kinaesthetic-sequences)
  > A significant editorial note records that this passage (through the end of §56) was published within the time-consciousness lectures (Husserliana X).

### 1910-1911 - Husserl, Hua 13 — Basic Problems of Phenomenology

`husserliana-13-basic-problems-of-phenomenology-commentary`

- **criticized** · `zeitlichkeit/hua13/001` · *now*
  The demand for nothing but the instantaneous now is said to annihilate its own object, since the now cannot be caught and registered without already being past.
  `husserliana-13-basic-problems-of-phenomenology-commentary#h3-s-24-the-absolute-givenness-of-the-phenomenologically-perceived-the-senselessnes` · § 24 · [§ 24\. The Absolute Givenness of the Phenomenologically Perceived. The Senselessness of a Switching-Off in Phenomenological Perception](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserliana-13-basic-problems-of-phenomenology-commentary.html#the-absolute-givenness-of-the-phenomenologically-perceived-the-senselessness-of-a-switching-off-in-phenomenological-perception)
  > Carried to the limit, the demand for nothing-but-the-instantaneous-now annihilates its own object, since the very now cannot be caught and registered without already being past.

- **introduced** · `zeitlichkeit/hua13/002` · *duration*
  The reduced perception taken as the enduring lived-experience it is counts as absolutely given, and shrinking it to a durationless instant is called a destruction rather than a heightening of evidence.
  `husserliana-13-basic-problems-of-phenomenology-commentary#h3-s-24-the-absolute-givenness-of-the-phenomenologically-perceived-the-senselessnes` · § 24 · [§ 24\. The Absolute Givenness of the Phenomenologically Perceived. The Senselessness of a Switching-Off in Phenomenological Perception](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserliana-13-basic-problems-of-phenomenology-commentary.html#the-absolute-givenness-of-the-phenomenologically-perceived-the-senselessness-of-a-switching-off-in-phenomenological-perception)
  > The reduced perception, taken purely as the enduring lived-experience it is, is the bedrock of indubitable givenness — and the attempt to shrink it to a durationless instant is not a heightening but a *destruction* of evidence.

- **presupposed** · `zeitlichkeit/hua13/003` · *retention, protention*
  A footnote is reported to set out the presupposed temporal structure: a flowing point of originary self-presence with a retentional horizon of the just-past and a protentional future-horizon.
  `husserliana-13-basic-problems-of-phenomenology-commentary#h3-s-24-the-absolute-givenness-of-the-phenomenologically-perceived-the-senselessnes` · § 24 · [§ 24\. The Absolute Givenness of the Phenomenologically Perceived. The Senselessness of a Switching-Off in Phenomenological Perception](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserliana-13-basic-problems-of-phenomenology-commentary.html#the-absolute-givenness-of-the-phenomenologically-perceived-the-senselessness-of-a-switching-off-in-phenomenological-perception)
  > the perception has a *flowing point of originary self-presence* and, beyond it, a *horizon of "retentional" givenness* as just-past, and on the other side an *immediate future-horizon of protentional givenness*

- **revised** · `zeitlichkeit/hua13/004` · *now*
  The now is called the eternally fleeing boundary-point between past and future, which could not even be asserted to be such if retention were switched off.
  `husserliana-13-basic-problems-of-phenomenology-commentary#h3-s-25-the-retention-implied-in-phenomenological-perception-as-a-transcendence-wit` · § 25 · [§ 25\. The Retention Implied in Phenomenological Perception as a "Transcendence" within the Phenomenological Attitude](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserliana-13-basic-problems-of-phenomenology-commentary.html#the-retention-implied-in-phenomenological-perception-as-a-transcendence-within-the-phenomenological-attitude)
  > The now is the *eternally fleeing boundary-point* between past and future — and even *that* it is this could not be asserted if we wanted to switch off *retention*.

- **introduced** · `zeitlichkeit/hua13/005` · *transcendence*
  A transcendence within the phenomenological attitude is admitted: not only retention but what it is retention of, every now of retention being retention of a just-having-been that is given.
  `husserliana-13-basic-problems-of-phenomenology-commentary#h3-s-25-the-retention-implied-in-phenomenological-perception-as-a-transcendence-wit` · § 25 · [§ 25\. The Retention Implied in Phenomenological Perception as a "Transcendence" within the Phenomenological Attitude](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserliana-13-basic-problems-of-phenomenology-commentary.html#the-retention-implied-in-phenomenological-perception-as-a-transcendence-within-the-phenomenological-attitude)
  > *Therewith we have admitted a "transcendence" within the phenomenological attitude*: insofar as we admit not only the retention *itself* as phenomenological being, but *also that of which it is retention*.

- **presupposed** · `zeitlichkeit/hua13/006` · *retentional evidence*
  Mistrusting retentional givenness is said to mean absolute skepticism, since that evidence is presupposed in empirical perception too.
  `husserliana-13-basic-problems-of-phenomenology-commentary#h3-s-25-the-retention-implied-in-phenomenological-perception-as-a-transcendence-wit` · § 25 · [§ 25\. The Retention Implied in Phenomenological Perception as a "Transcendence" within the Phenomenological Attitude](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserliana-13-basic-problems-of-phenomenology-commentary.html#the-retention-implied-in-phenomenological-perception-as-a-transcendence-within-the-phenomenological-attitude)
  > to *mistrust* such givenness would mean throwing ourselves into the arms of *absolute skepticism*; for such *retentional evidence* is presupposed *also in empirical perception*

- **introduced** · `zeitlichkeit/hua13/007` · *zeitlicher Hof*
  Every cogitatio is said to be surrounded by a temporal halo that must always be there and, where indeterminate, is determinable rather than freely variable.
  `husserliana-13-basic-problems-of-phenomenology-commentary#h3-s-37-the-principle-of-the-construction-of-a-unified-stream-of-consciousness` · § 37 · [§ 37\. The Principle of the Construction of a Unified Stream of Consciousness](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserliana-13-basic-problems-of-phenomenology-commentary.html#the-principle-of-the-construction-of-a-unified-stream-of-consciousness)
  > But it is *absolutely certain* that such a *temporal halo* (*zeitlicher Hof*) is *always there and must be there*, and that, where it is indeterminate, it is *not arbitrarily and freely variable but determinable*.

- **introduced** · `zeitlichkeit/hua13/008` · *time-unity*
  Two experiences joining into one synthetic consciousness join into one experience, to which belongs a time-unity of the experienced, and this is named the single principle constructing the unity of the stream.
  `husserliana-13-basic-problems-of-phenomenology-commentary#h3-s-37-the-principle-of-the-construction-of-a-unified-stream-of-consciousness` · § 37 · [§ 37\.   > Two experiences that join *at all* into the unity of a synthetic consciousness spanning them join therein into the unity of *one experience*; and to the unity of one experience there belongs, again, a *time-unity of the experienced*.

- **revised** · `zeitlichkeit/hua13/009` · *unity of the ego*
  The unity of the ego is said to be nothing but the lawful synthesizability of its cogitationes into one time, not a substantial pole behind them.
  `husserliana-13-basic-problems-of-phenomenology-commentary#h3-s-37-the-principle-of-the-construction-of-a-unified-stream-of-consciousness` · § 37 · [§ 37\. ### 1913-1928 - Husserl, Hua 3 — Ideas I, Parts 3–4

`husserliana-3-ideas-i-parts-3-4-commentary`

- **introduced** · `zeitlichkeit/hua3-34/001` · *phenomenological time*
  The transcendental absolute won by the reductions is admitted not to be the last thing: it constitutes itself and has its primal source in a last and truly absolute.
  `husserliana-3-ideas-i-parts-3-4-commentary#h3-s-81-phenomenological-time-and-time-consciousness` · Ideas I § 81 · [§ 81\. Phenomenological Time and Time-Consciousness](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserliana-3-ideas-i-parts-3-4-commentary.html#phenomenological-time-and-time-consciousness)
  > The transcendental "Absolute" that we have prepared out for ourselves through the reductions is in truth not the last thing; it is something that constitutes itself in a certain deep-lying and wholly peculiar sense, and has its primal source in a last and truly Absolute.

- **presupposed** · `zeitlichkeit/hua3-34/002` · *time-consciousness*
  The riddles of time-consciousness are set aside for the preparatory analyses, with a footnote reported as dating the completion of the relevant efforts to 1905 and the Göttingen lectures.
  `husserliana-3-ideas-i-parts-3-4-commentary#h3-s-81-phenomenological-time-and-time-consciousness` · Ideas I § 81 · [§ 81\. Phenomenological Time and Time-Consciousness](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserliana-3-ideas-i-parts-3-4-commentary.html#phenomenological-time-and-time-consciousness)
  > (A footnote notes that his long and long-vain efforts on this were essentially completed in 1905 and communicated in Göttingen university lectures, the time-consciousness lectures.)

- **introduced** · `zeitlichkeit/hua3-34/003` · *Zeitlichkeit*
  Temporality is said to designate not only something belonging to each single experience but a necessary form binding experiences with experiences into one infinite stream.
  `husserliana-3-ideas-i-parts-3-4-commentary#h3-s-81-phenomenological-time-and-time-consciousness` · Ideas I § 81 · [§ 81\. Phenomenological Time and Time-Consciousness](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserliana-3-ideas-i-parts-3-4-commentary.html#phenomenological-time-and-time-consciousness)
  > The essential property that the title temporality expresses for experiences in general designates not only something generally belonging to every single experience, but a necessary form binding experiences with experiences.

- **presupposed** · `zeitlichkeit/hua3-34/004` · *experience-stream*
  Single experiences can begin and end while the experience-stream cannot, and every experience as temporal being is the pure ego's, open to its reflective glance as enduring in phenomenological time.
  `husserliana-3-ideas-i-parts-3-4-commentary#h3-s-81-phenomenological-time-and-time-consciousness` · Ideas I § 81 · [§ 81\. Phenomenological Time and Time-Consciousness](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserliana-3-ideas-i-parts-3-4-commentary.html#phenomenological-time-and-time-consciousness)
  > But the experience-stream cannot begin and end. Every experience, as a temporal being, is experience of its pure ego.

- **introduced** · `zeitlichkeit/hua3-34/005` · *modes of givenness*
  No enduring experience is possible unless it constitutes itself in a continuous flux of givenness-modes, and that mode of givenness is itself an experience of a new kind and dimension.
  `husserliana-3-ideas-i-parts-3-4-commentary#h3-s-81-phenomenological-time-and-time-consciousness` · Ideas I § 81 · [§ 81\. Phenomenological Time and Time-Consciousness](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserliana-3-ideas-i-parts-3-4-commentary.html#phenomenological-time-and-time-consciousness)
  > no enduring experience is possible unless it constitutes itself in a continuous flux of givenness-modes as the unitary thing of the process, or of the duration; further, that this mode of givenness of the temporal experience is itself again an experience, though of a new kind and dimension

- **introduced** · `zeitlichkeit/hua3-34/006` · *now*
  The actual now is a punctual abiding form for ever new matter, and the just-nows are a continuity of forms of ever new content.
  `husserliana-3-ideas-i-parts-3-4-commentary#h3-s-81-phenomenological-time-and-time-consciousness` · Ideas I § 81 · [§ 81\. Phenomenological Time and Time-Consciousness](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserliana-3-ideas-i-parts-3-4-commentary.html#phenomenological-time-and-time-consciousness)
  > The actual now is necessarily, and remains, a punctual thing, an abiding form for ever new matter. Likewise with the continuity of the "just-nows"; it is a continuity of forms of ever new content.

- **introduced** · `zeitlichkeit/hua3-34/007` · *retention*
  The retentions are said not to be co-ordinate but nested, a continuous one-within-another of retentions of retentions, with impression continuously changing into retention.
  `husserliana-3-ideas-i-parts-3-4-commentary#h3-s-81-phenomenological-time-and-time-consciousness` · Ideas I § 81 · [§ 81\. Phenomenological Time and Time-Consciousness](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserliana-3-ideas-i-parts-3-4-commentary.html#phenomenological-time-and-time-consciousness)
  > one phase, impression, as limit-phase of a continuity of retentions, which are, however, not co-ordinate, but continuously-intentionally to be referred to one another, a continuous one-within-another of retentions of retentions

- **introduced** · `zeitlichkeit/hua3-34/008` · *protention*
  The structure is completed by the counter-direction: to the continuum of retentions corresponds one of protentions.
  `husserliana-3-ideas-i-parts-3-4-commentary#h3-s-81-phenomenological-time-and-time-consciousness` · Ideas I § 81 · [§ 81\. Phenomenological Time and Time-Consciousness](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserliana-3-ideas-i-parts-3-4-commentary.html#phenomenological-time-and-time-consciousness)
  > To this comes, however, the counter-direction of the continuous changes: to the before corresponds the after, to the continuum of retentions one of protentions.

- **introduced** · `zeitlichkeit/hua3-34/009` · *horizon*
  Every experience-now has a necessarily filled horizon of the before and of the after, so that even the onset-phase of a new experience has experiences preceding it.
  `husserliana-3-ideas-i-parts-3-4-commentary#h3-s-82-continuation-the-threefold-experience-horizon-at-the-same-time-as-the-horiz` · Ideas I § 82 · [§ 82\. Continuation.   > Every experience-now, even that of the onset-phase of a newly appearing experience, has necessarily its horizon of the before. But this can in principle be no empty before, an empty form without content, a nonsense.

  No experience can cease without a consciousness of the ceasing and the having-ceased, which is itself a new filled now, so the stream is an infinite unity.

  > One pure ego, one experience-stream filled in all three dimensions, essentially connected in this filling, demanding itself in its content-continuity: these are necessary correlates.

### 1917 to 1918 - Husserl, Hua 33 — Die Bernauer Manuskripte über das Zeitbewußtsein

`husserliana-33-die-bernauer-manuskripte-uber-das-zeitbewusstsein-commentary`

#### Bernau manuscripts, second stay, February-April 1918

- **introduced** · `zeitlichkeit/hua33/006` · *Abklang*
  The 1918 Bernau manuscripts are said to investigate fading, distinguished from retention, in which retentions of the remote past die off without egoic attention and their steady modification may cease.
  `husserliana-33-die-bernauer-manuskripte-uber-das-zeitbewusstsein-commentary#h2-iii` · [III](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserliana-33-die-bernauer-manuskripte-uber-das-zeitbewusstsein-commentary.html#iii)
  > The 1918 Bernau manuscripts devote detailed investigations to this phenomenon of "fading" (*Abklang*), distinguished from retention. Without active egoic attention, retentions of the remote past soon die off, and the process of their steady modification may cease.

#### Stratum not assigned by the commentary

- **presupposed** · `zeitlichkeit/hua33/001` · *retention*
  Retention is reported as Husserl's neologism for the present grasping of an objective past, understood as a modality of perceiving rather than as re-presentation or subsequent synthesis.
  `husserliana-33-die-bernauer-manuskripte-uber-das-zeitbewusstsein-commentary#h2-iii` · [III](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserliana-33-die-bernauer-manuskripte-uber-das-zeitbewusstsein-commentary.html#iii)
  > He differed substantively from Brentano and Meinong in that he understood retention neither as an act of (phantasy-like) re-presentation nor as a categorical act of subsequent synthesis, but rather as a modality of perceiving itself.

- **revised** · `zeitlichkeit/hua33/002` · *protention*
  Research into protention is said to have remained secondary in the earlier time-texts and to receive due attention, especially in its interweaving with retention, only in the Bernau manuscripts.
  `husserliana-33-die-bernauer-manuskripte-uber-das-zeitbewusstsein-commentary#h2-iii` · [III](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserliana-33-die-bernauer-manuskripte-uber-das-zeitbewusstsein-commentary.html#iii)
  > Research into the "protention"—the present grasping of, say, a future tone—remained secondary. Only in the Bernau manuscripts does protention and especially its interweaving with retention receive due attention.

- **revised** · `zeitlichkeit/hua33/003` · *Urimpression / Urpräsentation*
  The terminology for the originally present sensation shifts from primal impression in the earlier texts to primal presentation in the Bernau manuscripts.
  `husserliana-33-die-bernauer-manuskripte-uber-das-zeitbewusstsein-commentary#h2-iii` · [III](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserliana-33-die-bernauer-manuskripte-uber-das-zeitbewusstsein-commentary.html#iii)
  > Husserl calls the givenness of such an unmodified, originally present sensation an "Urimpression" in the earlier texts and an "Urpräsentation" (primal presentation) in the Bernau manuscripts.

- **revised** · `zeitlichkeit/hua33/004` · *Urprozeß / Urstrom*
  Absolute consciousness of the earlier texts is renamed primal process or primal stream, and immanent time-objects become temporal events, a change said to signal that the objectifying form of that consciousness is no longer taken for granted.
  `husserliana-33-die-bernauer-manuskripte-uber-das-zeitbewusstsein-commentary#h2-iii` · [III](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserliana-33-die-bernauer-manuskripte-uber-das-zeitbewusstsein-commentary.html#iii)
  > Husserl calls this inner consciousness of sensation "absolute consciousness" in the earlier texts and "Urprozeß" (primal process) or "Urstrom" (primal stream) in the Bernau manuscripts.

- **presupposed** · `zeitlichkeit/hua33/005` · *Querintentionalität / Längsintentionalität*
  The earlier solution to the regress is reported as the double intentionality of the retentional flow: transverse intentionality toward immanent time-objects and longitudinal intentionality as the flow's self-consciousness.
  `husserliana-33-die-bernauer-manuskripte-uber-das-zeitbewusstsein-commentary#h2-iii` · [III](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserliana-33-die-bernauer-manuskripte-uber-das-zeitbewusstsein-commentary.html#iii)
  > The flow of "absolute" retentional consciousness thus harbors a double intentionality: one directed at immanent time-objects ("transverse intentionality" / *Querintentionalität*) and one having the form of self-reference or self-consciousness of the flow ("longitudinal intentionality" / *Längsintentionalität*).

- **revised** · `zeitlichkeit/hua33/007` · *Urpräsentation*
  In the Bernau doctrine the primal presentation ceases to be the original core of time-consciousness and becomes a limit-point where the retentional and protentional modification-continua intersect.
  `husserliana-33-die-bernauer-manuskripte-uber-das-zeitbewusstsein-commentary#h2-iii` · [III](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserliana-33-die-bernauer-manuskripte-uber-das-zeitbewusstsein-commentary.html#iii)
  > The ur-presentation is now no longer the original core of time-consciousness but a mere limit-point where retentional and protentional modification-continua intersect.

- **revised** · `zeitlichkeit/hua33/008` · *Selbstbewußtsein des Urprozesses*
  According to the new Bernau doctrine, self-consciousness of the primal stream is no longer a retentional achievement but arises from the experience of present intuitive fulfillment and is anchored in the flowing present.
  `husserliana-33-die-bernauer-manuskripte-uber-das-zeitbewusstsein-commentary#h2-iii` · [III](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserliana-33-die-bernauer-manuskripte-uber-das-zeitbewusstsein-commentary.html#iii)
  > According to the new Bernau doctrine, self-consciousness arises from the experience of present intuitive fulfillment—the consciousness of the continuous transition from retentional protentions to their intuitive realization.

- **criticized** · `zeitlichkeit/hua33/009` · *infinite regress*
  The difficulty of infinite regress is said possibly to affect Husserl's whole systematic approach, since no determination of the origin of time may be available that does not already presuppose time.
  `husserliana-33-die-bernauer-manuskripte-uber-das-zeitbewusstsein-commentary#h2-iii` · [III](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserliana-33-die-bernauer-manuskripte-uber-das-zeitbewusstsein-commentary.html#iii)
  > Perhaps there simply can be no determination of the origin of time that does not already presuppose time.

- **introduced** · `zeitlichkeit/hua33/010` · *Ur-Präsentation*
  Every primal presence is held to be apprehended content and not merely content, so that primal presentation is fulfilled expectation.
  `husserliana-33-die-bernauer-manuskripte-uber-das-zeitbewusstsein-commentary#h4-s-2-the-interweaving-of-retentional-and-protentional-intentionality-in-the-cours` · Text Nr. 1, § 2 · [§ 2\. The Interweaving of Retentional and Protentional Intentionality in the Course of the Primal Process](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserliana-33-die-bernauer-manuskripte-uber-das-zeitbewusstsein-commentary.html#the-interweaving-of-retentional-and-protentional-intentionality-in-the-course-of-the-primal-process)
  > Every ur-presence is thus not merely content but "apprehended" content. Ur-presentation is fulfilled expectation.

- **revised** · `zeitlichkeit/hua33/011` · *retention*
  Every middle phase of the process is given a triple face: retention of the elapsed ur-data, retention of the elapsed apprehensions, and fulfilled expectation from which an empty horizon radiates.
  `husserliana-33-die-bernauer-manuskripte-uber-das-zeitbewusstsein-commentary#h4-s-2-the-interweaving-of-retentional-and-protentional-intentionality-in-the-cours` · Text Nr. 1, § 2 · [§ 2\. The Interweaving of Retentional and Protentional Intentionality in the Course of the Primal Process](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserliana-33-die-bernauer-manuskripte-uber-das-zeitbewusstsein-commentary.html#the-interweaving-of-retentional-and-protentional-intentionality-in-the-course-of-the-primal-process)
  > Every middle phase (excluding onset and end phases) thus has a triple face: it is retention with respect to the elapsed system of ur-data, retention with respect to the elapsed consciousness-apprehensions, and therefore fulfilled expectation—from which unfulfilled expectation radiates

- **introduced** · `zeitlichkeit/hua33/012` · *protention*
  Protention is not a point-to-point aiming that flashes up anew at each phase but one continuously mediate intention directed at the coming event as a flowing horizon.
  `husserliana-33-die-bernauer-manuskripte-uber-das-zeitbewusstsein-commentary#h4-s-3-the-role-of-expectations-protentions-in-the-constitution-of-phenomenological` · Text Nr. 1, § 3 · [§ 3\. The Role of "Expectations" (Protentions) in the Constitution of Phenomenological Time. Continuous Modification of the Double Intentionality in the Protentional Fulfillment-Process and the Retentional De-fulfillment Process](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserliana-33-die-bernauer-manuskripte-uber-das-zeitbewusstsein-commentary.html#the-role-of-expectations-protentions-in-the-constitution-of-phenomenological-time-continuous-modification-of-the-double-intentionality-in-the-protentional-fulfillment-process-and-the-retentional-de-fulfillment-process)
  > The expectation targets the coming event, a flowing event-horizon, a variable stretch. Its intentionality is continuously mediately directed at everything ideally distinguishable in what is coming.

- **introduced** · `zeitlichkeit/hua33/013` · *Entfüllung*
  The protentional and retentional series are made symmetrical in implication and asymmetrical in fullness: the empty protentions come first and fill, the full retentions come first and de-fulfill.
  `husserliana-33-die-bernauer-manuskripte-uber-das-zeitbewusstsein-commentary#h4-s-3-the-role-of-expectations-protentions-in-the-constitution-of-phenomenological` · Text Nr. 1, § 3 · [§ 3\. Continuous Modification of the Double Intentionality in the Protentional Fulfillment-Process and the Retentional De-fulfillment Process](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserliana-33-die-bernauer-manuskripte-uber-das-zeitbewusstsein-commentary.html#the-role-of-expectations-protentions-in-the-constitution-of-phenomenological-time-continuous-modification-of-the-double-intentionality-in-the-protentional-fulfillment-process-and-the-retentional-de-fulfillment-process)
  > since in the flow of the primal process the empty (relatively empty) protentions come first and the full ones follow, while the full (relatively full) retentions come first and the relatively empty ones follow

  > The Now is constituted through the form of protentional fulfillment; the past through retentional modification of this fulfillment.

- **introduced** · `zeitlichkeit/hua33/015` · *Urgesetz der Genesis*
  A primal law of genesis is invoked: once a stretch of hyletic data has elapsed a retentional connection must form, and a protention directs itself at continuation in the same style, modified by each differential of the retentional course.

  > Consciousness remains in its course and anticipates the further: a protention "directs" itself at continuation in the same style, and this protention is modified by each differential of the retentional course.

  Every process-phase is given a three-part structure: a stretch of retention, a point of primal presentation as fulfilled protention, and a stretch of unfulfilled protention.

### 1920-1921 to 1925-1926 - Husserl Passive Synthesis Commentary

`husserliana-11-analyses-concerning-passive-and-active-synthesis-commentary`

#### First delivery, WS 1920/21

- **presupposed** · `zeitlichkeit/hua11/008` · *retention, protention*
  The 1920/21 first version already lays out the typology of presentations - perception, retention, protention, remembering, expectation, co-presentification - each with its temporal orientation.
  `husserliana-11-analyses-concerning-passive-and-active-synthesis-commentary#h3-section-1-first-version-of-main-text-part-2-1920-21` · Supplementary Texts, § 10 (pp. 375-379) · [Section 1: First Version of Main Text Part 2 (1920/21)](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserliana-11-analyses-concerning-passive-and-active-synthesis-commentary.html#section-1-first-version-of-main-text-part-2-192021)
  > Husserl lays out the basic typology of presentations: perception, retention, protention, remembering, expectation, co-presentification—each with its distinctive temporal orientation and mode of giving its object.

- **presupposed** · `zeitlichkeit/hua11/009` · *Vergegenwärtigung*
  The 1920/21 version analyses retention, empty expectation and presentifications of what is temporally present as necessary components of perceptual lived-experience.
  `husserliana-11-analyses-concerning-passive-and-active-synthesis-commentary#h3-section-1-first-version-of-main-text-part-2-1920-21` · Supplementary Texts, §§ 5-9 (pp. 367-374) · [Section 1: First Version of Main Text Part 2 (1920/21)](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserliana-11-analyses-concerning-passive-and-active-synthesis-commentary.html#section-1-first-version-of-main-text-part-2-192021)
  > Husserl analyzes the various forms of presentification (Vergegenwärtigung) as necessary components of perceptual lived-experience: concrete retention and its modalization, empty concrete expectation and its modalization, and concrete empty presentifications of what is temporally present.

#### Stratum not assigned by the commentary

- **presupposed** · `zeitlichkeit/hua11/001` · *retention*
  Every intuition leaves an empty presentation that is a retention, and the continual retentional modification of each primordially impressional Now-phase is called the first aspect of the fundamental lawfulness of original time-consciousness.
  `husserliana-11-analyses-concerning-passive-and-active-synthesis-commentary#h3-s18-description-of-the-possible-types-of-empty-presentation` · § 18 · [§18. Description of the Possible Types of Empty Presentation](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserliana-11-analyses-concerning-passive-and-active-synthesis-commentary.html#description-of-the-possible-types-of-empty-presentation)
  > every such empty presentation is a retention, and its necessary connection to past intentions characterizes a fundamental law of passive genesis. This extends into every intuition itself: every Now-phase arising primordially-impressionally is continually modified in retention—the first aspect of fundamental lawfulness of original time-consciousness.

- **introduced** · `zeitlichkeit/hua11/002` · *protention*
  Protention is the second aspect of genetic primordial lawfulness, and the protentional and retentional continuities are distinguished by the direction the egoic regard must take in each.
  `husserliana-11-analyses-concerning-passive-and-active-synthesis-commentary#h3-s18-description-of-the-possible-types-of-empty-presentation` · § 18 · [§18. Description of the Possible Types of Empty Presentation](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserliana-11-analyses-concerning-passive-and-active-synthesis-commentary.html#description-of-the-possible-types-of-empty-presentation)
  > Alongside retentions, there are protentions: the second aspect of genetic primordial lawfulness. Just as a retentional horizon is invariably connected to each impressional present, so is a protentional horizon.

- **criticized** · `zeitlichkeit/hua11/003` · *original association*
  Brentano is said to be phenomenologically incorrect in calling the connection of retentions to impressions original association, since the synthesis proper to original time-consciousness is not associative.
  `husserliana-11-analyses-concerning-passive-and-active-synthesis-commentary#h3-s18-description-of-the-possible-types-of-empty-presentation` · § 18 · [§18. Description of the Possible Types of Empty Presentation](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserliana-11-analyses-concerning-passive-and-active-synthesis-commentary.html#description-of-the-possible-types-of-empty-presentation)
  > Therefore Brentano was phenomenologically incorrect to characterize the connection of retentions to impressions as "original association." Association is only at work in the protentional path of time-constitution, alongside the continual retentional path.

- **revised** · `zeitlichkeit/hua11/004` · *retention*
  Retentions can take on intentional character only later, through subsequent association, so that the distinction between mere retentions prior to association and their intentional shape is fundamental.
  `husserliana-11-analyses-concerning-passive-and-active-synthesis-commentary#h3-s18-description-of-the-possible-types-of-empty-presentation` · § 18 · [§18. Description of the Possible Types of Empty Presentation](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserliana-11-analyses-concerning-passive-and-active-synthesis-commentary.html#description-of-the-possible-types-of-empty-presentation)

  Time and space are made principles of individuation: objects uniform in all material respects are individuated by their unique temporal locus, temporal shape being distinguished from temporal identity.

  > Even objects uniform in all material respects are individuated by their different temporal positions. Time and space (for the visual field) are *principia individuationis*—the forms of possible individuality of objects given in the living present.

  > The a-temporality of judgments is itself a distinctive shape of temporality: *omni-temporality*.

- **presupposed** · `zeitlichkeit/hua11/007` · *temporal being*
  The original core of the judgment's being is a being in the form of temporality but not the being of an individuum, and the difference between individual and ideal temporal being is called fundamental.
  `husserliana-11-analyses-concerning-passive-and-active-synthesis-commentary#h3-s56-the-ideality-of-the-judicative-proposition-in-the-sense-of-omni-temporality` · § 56 · [§56.   > The original core of judgment's being is a being in the form of temporality—but not the being of an *individuum*. The difference between individual and ideal temporal being is fundamental.

  The world is characterised as an all-temporal universe extending through all its past and its entire open future rather than as an unchangeable present-universe of pre-givennesses.
  `husserliana-39-die-lebenswelt-commentary#h3-text-nr-6-universe-of-pre-givenness-and-world-constitution-of-the-universe-of-pr` · Text Nr. 6, pp. 50-51 · [Text Nr. 6. ### 1921-1922 - Heidegger, GA 61 — Phenomenological Interpretations of Aristotle

`heidegger-ga-61-phenomenological-interpretations-of-aristotle-commentary`

- **introduced** · `zeitlichkeit/ga61/001` · *Zeitigungssinn*
  Comportment is determined in several respects, among them the temporalizing sense: the way the enactment becomes and is in and for its situation.
  `heidegger-ga-61-phenomenological-interpretations-of-aristotle-commentary#h4-b-comportment` · [B. Comportment](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/heidegger/heidegger-ga-61-phenomenological-interpretations-of-aristotle-commentary.html#b-comportment)
  > as the way the enactment becomes and is in and for its situation — temporalizing sense (*Zeitigungssinn*)

- **presupposed** · `zeitlichkeit/ga61/002` · *temporalizing*
  Of the two senses of comportment, the enactment sense together with the relational sense is called temporalizing, existence, while the relation detached from enactment becomes objectified intentionality.
  `heidegger-ga-61-phenomenological-interpretations-of-aristotle-commentary#h4-b-comportment` · [B. Comportment](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/heidegger/heidegger-ga-61-phenomenological-interpretations-of-aristotle-commentary.html#b-comportment)
  > The first equals enactment (*Vollzug*) in the broader sense, and "together" with the second, temporalizing, existence. The second is relation (*Bezug*), and detached from the first, it becomes objectified intentionality.

- **introduced** · `zeitlichkeit/ga61/003` · *co-temporalizes*
  The nothing toward which factical life falls is said to co-temporalize the fall, the fall being formed from a whither that temporalizes itself in concern.
  `heidegger-ga-61-phenomenological-interpretations-of-aristotle-commentary#h5-b-the-whither-of-ruinance-the-nothing` · [b) The Whither of Ruinance: The Nothing](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/heidegger/heidegger-ga-61-phenomenological-interpretations-of-aristotle-commentary.html#b-the-whither-of-ruinance-the-nothing)
  > This nothing is a possibility that precisely does not give standing, accommodation, does not catch the fall and end it, but is something that factically co-temporalizes the fall. The fall is in a peculiar way formed from its whither, which for its part temporalizes itself in concern.

- **introduced** · `zeitlichkeit/ga61/004` · *the still*
  The still of the still-being-there of environmental life is called a characteristic determination of the temporality at work in ruinance.
  `heidegger-ga-61-phenomenological-interpretations-of-aristotle-commentary#h5-b-the-whither-of-ruinance-the-nothing` · [b) The Whither of Ruinance: The Nothing](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/heidegger/heidegger-ga-61-phenomenological-interpretations-of-aristotle-commentary.html#b-the-whither-of-ruinance-the-nothing)
  > It is factically "still" there so; the "still" is again a characteristic determination of the temporality at work here.

- **introduced** · `zeitlichkeit/ga61/005` · *temporalizing-succession*
  The before of presupposition is distinguished as logical and as temporal, the latter belonging to an enactment- and temporalizing-succession of factical life rather than a theoretical grounding-connection.
  `heidegger-ga-61-phenomenological-interpretations-of-aristotle-commentary#h2-appendix-i-presupposition` · [Appendix I: Presupposition](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/heidegger/heidegger-ga-61-phenomenological-interpretations-of-aristotle-commentary.html#appendix-i-presupposition)
  > (2) the "before" as temporally in the sense of "previously," "first," at the same time as in advance — in the series of positings connected in a non-logical succession, an enactment- and temporalizing-succession of factical life

### 1923-1924 - Husserl, Hua 7 — Erste Philosophie I

`husserliana-7-erste-philosophie-i-commentary`

- **introduced** · `zeitlichkeit/hua7/001` · *immanent time-stream*
  The real piece of an experience is every itself-immanent temporal component of the experience-process, while memories and expectations of the same are separated experiences in immanent temporality with no piece in common.
  `husserliana-7-erste-philosophie-i-commentary#h3-fifteenth-lecture-the-problem-of-immanence-and-of-the-synthetic-unity-in-conscio` · Fifteenth Lecture · [Fifteenth Lecture: The problem of immanence and of the synthetic unity in consciousness](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserliana-7-erste-philosophie-i-commentary.html#fifteenth-lecture-the-problem-of-immanence-and-of-the-synthetic-unity-in-consciousness)
  > Real piece of the experience, as datum of the immanent time-stream, is every itself-immanent temporal component of the experience-process; but the manifold memories or expectations in which we re-remember the same or pre-expect the same are, in the immanent temporality, *separated* experiences and can have no piece in common.

- **presupposed** · `zeitlichkeit/hua7/002` · *remembered past*
  The past of which we are mindful is remembered past and the future expected is foreseen future, neither being a real component of the present experiencing.
  `husserliana-7-erste-philosophie-i-commentary#h3-fifteenth-lecture-the-problem-of-immanence-and-of-the-synthetic-unity-in-conscio` · Fifteenth Lecture · [Fifteenth Lecture: The problem of immanence and of the synthetic unity in consciousness](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserliana-7-erste-philosophie-i-commentary.html#fifteenth-lecture-the-problem-of-immanence-and-of-the-synthetic-unity-in-consciousness)
  > The past of which we are mindful is, in the remembering itself, *remembered* past; the future we expect, in the expected itself, *foreseen* future; but as little as the actual past or future is the "meant as such," the "immanent intentional" one, a *real component* in the present experiencing.

- **presupposed** · `zeitlichkeit/hua7/003` · *inner temporal processes*
  Consciousness can also be described according to its real pieces, a predicative judgment having its steps and pieces as inner temporal processes.
  `husserliana-7-erste-philosophie-i-commentary#h3-fifteenth-lecture-the-problem-of-immanence-and-of-the-synthetic-unity-in-conscio` · Fifteenth Lecture · [Fifteenth Lecture: The problem of immanence and of the synthetic unity in consciousness](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserliana-7-erste-philosophie-i-commentary.html#fifteenth-lecture-the-problem-of-immanence-and-of-the-synthetic-unity-in-consciousness)
  > evidently a predicative judgment has its set-off steps and pieces, as inner temporal processes — its subject-positing, its predicate-positing referred to it

- **revised** · `zeitlichkeit/hua7/004` · *immanent time*
  Experiences considered exclusively as events running in the universal form of immanent time admit a kind of material description, to which belongs the fleetingness of ideas against impressions.
  `husserliana-7-erste-philosophie-i-commentary#h3-twenty-third-lecture-hume-s-nominalistic-reduction-of-all-ideas-to-impressions-a` · Twenty-third Lecture · [Twenty-third Lecture: Hume's nominalistic reduction of all ideas to impressions and the countersense in this principle](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserliana-7-erste-philosophie-i-commentary.html#twenty-third-lecture-humes-nominalistic-reduction-of-all-ideas-to-impressions-and-the-countersense-in-this-principle)
  > immanent experiences, insofar as they are considered *exclusively* as events running in the universal form of immanent time, stretching through an immanent time-stretch, have also a kind of construction out of real parts and peculiarities that makes possible a kind of *material description*

- **criticized** · `zeitlichkeit/hua7/005` · *individual quasi-being*
  Hume's grading of liveliness is challenged as possibly confusing a mode of intentional intuitiveness with a mode of individual quasi-being in immanent temporality.
  `husserliana-7-erste-philosophie-i-commentary#h3-twenty-third-lecture-hume-s-nominalistic-reduction-of-all-ideas-to-impressions-a` · Twenty-third Lecture · [Twenty-third Lecture: Hume's nominalistic reduction of all ideas to impressions and the countersense in this principle](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserliana-7-erste-philosophie-i-commentary.html#twenty-third-lecture-humes-nominalistic-reduction-of-all-ideas-to-impressions-and-the-countersense-in-this-principle)
  > whether one may seriously also reckon here intensity-like differences of liveliness, and whether already here a mode of *intentional intuitiveness* is not confused with a mode of *individual quasi-being* in the immanent temporality, would still be seriously to weigh

- **criticized** · `zeitlichkeit/hua7/006` · *presentification*
  The material description is charged with failing on its own terms, since the word perception already carries the intentional reference to something as present, past or fictive.
  `husserliana-7-erste-philosophie-i-commentary#h3-twenty-third-lecture-hume-s-nominalistic-reduction-of-all-ideas-to-impressions-a` · Twenty-third Lecture · [Twenty-third Lecture: Hume's nominalistic reduction of all ideas to impressions and the countersense in this principle](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserliana-7-erste-philosophie-i-commentary.html#twenty-third-lecture-humes-nominalistic-reduction-of-all-ideas-to-impressions-and-the-countersense-in-this-principle)
  > the single word "perception" already carries the intentional reference (of something, as present, as past, as fictive) that Hume's material description cannot account for, so the description fails on its own terms

- **introduced** · `zeitlichkeit/bt/002` · *Gewesenheit*

- **introduced** · `zeitlichkeit/bt/004` · *Zeitlichkeit*
  The meaning of care is temporality, with existentiality grounded in the future, facticity in having-been and falling in the present, the three ecstases constituting one unitary phenomenon.

Temporality as the Ontological Meaning of Care](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/heidegger/heidegger-being-and-time-commentary.html#temporality-as-the-ontological-meaning-of-care)
  > These three ecstases — future, having-been, present — constitute the primordial unity of temporality. Temporality is the primordial "outside-itself" (*Außer-sich*) in and for itself. ### 1929 to 1937 - Husserl formal and transcendental logic

`husserl-formal-and-transcendental-logic-commentary`

- **introduced** · `zeitlichkeit/ftl/001` · *immanent temporality*
  Genetic intentional analysis is directed at the whole concrete context, bringing into question the immanent unity of the temporality of life in which life has its history.
  `husserl-formal-and-transcendental-logic-commentary#h4-b-intentional-explication-of-genesis-genetic-as-well-as-static-originality-of-th` · Appendix II, § 2 b · [b) Intentional Explication of Genesis. Genetic as Well as Static Originality of the Experiencing Givenness-Mode. "Original Institution" of the "Apperception" for Every Object-Category](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserl-formal-and-transcendental-logic-commentary.html#b-intentional-explication-of-genesis-genetic-as-well-as-static-originality-of-the-experiencing-givenness-mode-original-institution-of-the-apperception-for-every-object-category)
  > The immanent unity of the temporality of life comes into question, in which life has its "history."

- **introduced** · `zeitlichkeit/ftl/002` · *original institution*
  No non-original consciousness-mode is essentially possible unless the corresponding original mode has previously occurred in the synthetic unity of immanent temporality as the originally instituting one.
  `husserl-formal-and-transcendental-logic-commentary#h4-b-intentional-explication-of-genesis-genetic-as-well-as-static-originality-of-th` · Appendix II, § 2 b · [b) Intentional Explication of Genesis. Genetic as Well as Static Originality of the Experiencing Givenness-Mode. "Original Institution" of the "Apperception" for Every Object-Category](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserl-formal-and-transcendental-logic-commentary.html#b-intentional-explication-of-genesis-genetic-as-well-as-static-originality-of-the-experiencing-givenness-mode-original-institution-of-the-apperception-for-every-object-category)
  > For every fundamental kind of objectualities, no non-original consciousness-mode is essentially possible unless the corresponding original consciousness-mode has previously occurred in the synthetic unity of immanent temporality as the genetically "originally instituting" one.

- **introduced** · `zeitlichkeit/ftl/003` · *time-form*
  The universal essential form of intentional genesis is the constitution of immanent temporality, in which every experience receives its identical time-position and enduringly retains it.
  `husserl-formal-and-transcendental-logic-commentary#h4-c-the-time-form-of-intentional-genesis-and-its-constitution-retentional-modifica` · Appendix II, § 2 c · [c) The Time-Form of Intentional Genesis and Its Constitution. Retentional Modification. Sedimentation in the Background of Non-Prominence (Unconsciousness)](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserl-formal-and-transcendental-logic-commentary.html#c-the-time-form-of-intentional-genesis-and-its-constitution-retentional-modification-sedimentation-in-the-background-of-non-prominence-unconsciousness)
  > The universal essential form of intentional genesis is the constitution of immanent temporality: every consciousness-experience, in the streaming change of typically modified givenness-modes within a living present, receives its identical time-position and then enduringly retains it.

- **presupposed** · `zeitlichkeit/ftl/004` · *retentional modification*
  Retentional consciousness attaches in unalterable necessity to every experience in the primal mode, each modification functioning as a relative primal mode for a new one and pointing back to its absolute primal mode.
  `husserl-formal-and-transcendental-logic-commentary#h4-c-the-time-form-of-intentional-genesis-and-its-constitution-retentional-modifica` · Appendix II, § 2 c · [c) The Time-Form of Intentional Genesis and Its Constitution. Retentional Modification. Sedimentation in the Background of Non-Prominence (Unconsciousness)](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserl-formal-and-transcendental-logic-commentary.html#c-the-time-form-of-intentional-genesis-and-its-constitution-retentional-modification-sedimentation-in-the-background-of-non-prominence-unconsciousness)
  > Each modification functions according to the same lawfulness as a relative primal mode for a new modification, and so continuously onward. Each modification points back to its absolute primal mode.

- **introduced** · `zeitlichkeit/ftl/005` · *sedimentation*
  The retentional self-modification runs to an essential limit where the prominent flows into the background, the so-called unconscious, called a limit-mode of consciousness and not a phenomenological nothing.
  `husserl-formal-and-transcendental-logic-commentary#h4-c-the-time-form-of-intentional-genesis-and-its-constitution-retentional-modifica` · Appendix II, § 2 c · [c) The Time-Form of Intentional Genesis and Its Constitution. Retentional Modification. Sedimentation in the Background of Non-Prominence (Unconsciousness)](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserl-formal-and-transcendental-logic-commentary.html#c-the-time-form-of-intentional-genesis-and-its-constitution-retentional-modification-sedimentation-in-the-background-of-non-prominence-unconsciousness)
  > this has its limit where the previously prominent flows into the general background — the so-called "unconscious," which is nothing less than a phenomenological nothing but itself a limit-mode of consciousness

- **introduced** · `zeitlichkeit/ftl/006` · *secondary sensibility*
  The retentional is the first-in-itself non-original givenness-mode of the judgment, the original action transforming in retentional continuity into a passive form of secondary sensibility.
  `husserl-formal-and-transcendental-logic-commentary#h4-a-the-retentional-as-the-first-in-itself-form-of-secondary-sensibility-the-livin` · Appendix II, § 3 a · [a) The Retentional, as the First-in-Itself Form of "Secondary Sensibility." The Livingly Self-Transforming Constitution of a Many-Membered Judgment](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserl-formal-and-transcendental-logic-commentary.html#a-the-retentional-as-the-first-in-itself-form-of-secondary-sensibility-the-livingly-self-transforming-constitution-of-a-many-membered-judgment)
  > The original action transforms in retentional continuity into a secondary form that is no longer activity, a passive form — a form of "secondary sensibility."

- **presupposed** · `zeitlichkeit/ftl/007` · *retention*
  This retention alone is said to make possible progressive judgment-processes as the living further-formation of categorial meanings into higher-level judgments.
  `husserl-formal-and-transcendental-logic-commentary#h4-a-the-retentional-as-the-first-in-itself-form-of-secondary-sensibility-the-livin` · Appendix II, § 3 a · [a) The Retentional, as the First-in-Itself Form of "Secondary Sensibility." The Livingly Self-Transforming Constitution of a Many-Membered Judgment](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserl-formal-and-transcendental-logic-commentary.html#a-the-retentional-as-the-first-in-itself-form-of-secondary-sensibility-the-livingly-self-transforming-constitution-of-a-many-membered-judgment)
  > This kind of retention alone makes possible progressive judgment-processes as living further-formation and connection of categorial meanings to the unity of ever-new and higher-level judgments.

*Partial pass: Appendix II §§ 2 b-c and § 3 a, where the time-form of intentional genesis and the retentional modification are set out. The nine other sections with term hits are not extracted.*

### 1929 to 1931 - Husserl Cartesian Meditations Analysis

`husserliana-1-cartesianische-meditationen-commentary`

- **introduced** · `zeitlichkeit/hua1/001` · *inner time-consciousness*
  Identification is met first as an all-pervasive passively proceeding synthesis in the form of continuous inner time-consciousness, every experience having its experience-temporality.
  `husserliana-1-cartesianische-meditationen-commentary#h3-s-18-identification-as-a-fundamental-form-of-synthesis-universal-synthesis-of-tr` · § 18 · [§ 18. Identification as a Fundamental Form of Synthesis. Universal Synthesis of Transcendental Time](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserliana-1-cartesianische-meditationen-commentary.html#identification-as-a-fundamental-form-of-synthesis-universal-synthesis-of-transcendental-time)
  > It confronts us first as an all-pervasive, passively proceeding synthesis in the form of the continuous inner time-consciousness. Every experience has its experience-temporality.

- **introduced** · `zeitlichkeit/hua1/002` · *objective and inner temporality*
  The objective temporality that appears is to be distinguished from the inner temporality of the appearing, which streams along in phases that are changing appearances of the same object.
  `husserliana-1-cartesianische-meditationen-commentary#h3-s-18-identification-as-a-fundamental-form-of-synthesis-universal-synthesis-of-tr` · § 18 · [§ 18. Identification as a Fundamental Form of Synthesis. Universal Synthesis of Transcendental Time](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserliana-1-cartesianische-meditationen-commentary.html#identification-as-a-fundamental-form-of-synthesis-universal-synthesis-of-transcendental-time)
  > we must distinguish the objective temporality that appears — e.g., that of this cube — from the inner temporality of the appearing (e.g., of the cube-perceiving)

- **introduced** · `zeitlichkeit/hua1/003` · *immanent temporality*
  All-encompassing inner time-consciousness is called the fundamental form of the universal synthesis that makes all other syntheses possible, its correlate being immanent temporality itself.
  `husserliana-1-cartesianische-meditationen-commentary#h3-s-18-identification-as-a-fundamental-form-of-synthesis-universal-synthesis-of-tr` · § 18 · [§ 18. Identification as a Fundamental Form of Synthesis. Universal Synthesis of Transcendental Time](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserliana-1-cartesianische-meditationen-commentary.html#identification-as-a-fundamental-form-of-synthesis-universal-synthesis-of-transcendental-time)
  > The fundamental form of this universal synthesis, which makes all other syntheses of consciousness possible, is the all-encompassing inner time-consciousness. Its correlate is immanent temporality itself

- **presupposed** · `zeitlichkeit/hua1/004` · *horizon of immanent time*
  All experiences of the ego found in reflection must present themselves as temporally ordered within the constant infinite horizon of immanent time.
  `husserliana-1-cartesianische-meditationen-commentary#h3-s-18-identification-as-a-fundamental-form-of-synthesis-universal-synthesis-of-tr` · § 18 · [§ 18. Identification as a Fundamental Form of Synthesis. Universal Synthesis of Transcendental Time](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserliana-1-cartesianische-meditationen-commentary.html#identification-as-a-fundamental-form-of-synthesis-universal-synthesis-of-transcendental-time)
  > according to which all experiences of the ego, reflectively found, must present themselves as temporally ordered — as temporally beginning and ending, as simultaneous and successive — within the constant infinite horizon of immanent time

- **introduced** · `zeitlichkeit/hua1/005` · *universal temporality*
  Essential laws of egological-temporal coexistence and succession are said to govern compossibility, everything emerging in the ego having its temporality and partaking in the form-system of universal temporality.
  `husserliana-1-cartesianische-meditationen-commentary#h3-s-36-the-transcendental-ego-as-the-universe-of-possible-forms-of-experience-esse` · § 36 · [§ 36. The Transcendental Ego as the Universe of Possible Forms of Experience. Essential-Lawful Regulation of the Compossibility of Experiences in Coexistence and Succession](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserliana-1-cartesianische-meditationen-commentary.html#the-transcendental-ego-as-the-universe-of-possible-forms-of-experience-essential-lawful-regulation-of-the-compossibility-of-experiences-in-coexistence-and-succession)
  > Essential laws of egological-temporal coexistence and succession govern. Whatever emerges in my ego — in intentional experiences, in constituted unities, in ego-habitualities — has its temporality and partakes in the form-system of universal temporality.

## Reception layer

*Read alongside the spine, not on it. A commentator's date orders the reception, not the doctrine.*

### 1961 - Derrida, Introduction à L'Origine de la géométrie

`derrida-introduction-a-lorigine-de-la-geometrie-commentary`

- **introduced** · `zeitlichkeit/derrida-intro/001` · *Allzeitlichkeit*
  Supratemporality and timelessness are said to be defined negatively only relative to mundane temporality; once that is reduced they appear as omnitemporality, a concrete mode of temporality in general.
  `derrida-introduction-a-lorigine-de-la-geometrie-commentary#h2-vi` · ¶ 112 · [VI](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/derrida/derrida-introduction-a-lorigine-de-la-geometrie-commentary.html#vi)
  > *Überzeitlichkeit* and *Zeitlosigkeit* are defined in their transcendence or negativity *only relative to mundane temporality*; once the latter is reduced, they appear as *Allzeitlichkeit* — omnitemporality, "*a concrete mode of temporality in general*."

- **revised** · `zeitlichkeit/derrida-intro/002` · *supratemporality*
  Supratemporality is denied to be an escape from time and called time's own universal mode, on the same reversal by which linguistic embodiment delivers rather than imprisons ideality.
  `derrida-introduction-a-lorigine-de-la-geometrie-commentary#h2-vi` · ¶ 112 · [VI](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/derrida/derrida-introduction-a-lorigine-de-la-geometrie-commentary.html#vi)
  > Supratemporality is thus not an escape from time but time's own universal mode — just as linguistic embodiment is not ideality's prison but its deliverance.

- **revised** · `zeitlichkeit/derrida-intro/003` · *omnitemporality*
  The eternity of the Idea and of Reason is redefined as a historicity, its supra-temporality with regard to empirical temporality being nothing but an omnitemporality.
  `derrida-introduction-a-lorigine-de-la-geometrie-commentary#h2-xi` · ¶ 51 · [XI](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/derrida/derrida-introduction-a-lorigine-de-la-geometrie-commentary.html#xi)
  > But this eternity *is nothing but a historicity*. It is the possibility of history itself. Its *supra-temporality* — with regard to empirical temporality — *is nothing but an omnitemporality*.

- **presupposed** · `zeitlichkeit/derrida-intro/004` · *protention and retention*
  Primordial temporalization is called dialectical through and through, as the dialectic of the mutual implication of protentions and retentions with the non-dialectic identity of the Living Present.
  `derrida-introduction-a-lorigine-de-la-geometrie-commentary#h2-xi` · ¶ 235 · [XI](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/derrida/derrida-introduction-a-lorigine-de-la-geometrie-commentary.html#xi)
  > it was only the *dialectic of the dialectic* — the indefinite, mutual and irreducible implication of protentions and retentions — *with the non-dialectic*: the absolute and concrete identity of the Living Present, universal form of all consciousness.

- **revised** · `zeitlichkeit/derrida-intro/005` · *Living Present*
  The coincidence of constituting and constituted moment is reread as a unity of non-coincidence and indefinite co-implication in a Living Present that projects and maintains itself dialectically.
  `derrida-introduction-a-lorigine-de-la-geometrie-commentary#h2-xi` · ¶ 235 · [XI](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/derrida/derrida-introduction-a-lorigine-de-la-geometrie-commentary.html#xi)
  > the unity of the *non-coincidence* and the *indefinite co-implication* of the constituted moment and the constituting moment, in the absolute identity of a Living Present that *projects and maintains itself dialectically*.

- **revised** · `zeitlichkeit/derrida-intro/006` · *Zeitlichkeit*
  Supra-temporality and omni-temporality are asked to be characters of Time itself, of the Living Present as the absolute concrete form of phenomenological temporality.
  `derrida-introduction-a-lorigine-de-la-geometrie-commentary#h2-xi` · ¶ 257 · [XI](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/derrida/derrida-introduction-a-lorigine-de-la-geometrie-commentary.html#xi)
  > Are not supra-temporality and omni-temporality *also the characters of Time itself*? — of the *Living Present*, which is the absolute concrete *Form* of phenomenological temporality and the primordial Absolute of all transcendental life?

- **introduced** · `zeitlichkeit/derrida-intro/007` · *historicity*
  The hidden temporal unity of supra-temporality and omni-temporality is declared the unitary foundation of all the instances the reductions dissociated, and that unity is historicity itself.
  `derrida-introduction-a-lorigine-de-la-geometrie-commentary#h2-xi` · ¶ 257 · [XI](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/derrida/derrida-introduction-a-lorigine-de-la-geometrie-commentary.html#xi)
  > This unity — "as *temporal* unity of temporality, for every *Geschehen*, for all *history* as the *gathering of what comes to pass in general*" — "*is historicity itself*."

- **presupposed** · `zeitlichkeit/derrida-intro/008` · *temporalization*
  Intentionality, traditionality, temporalization and historicity are said to be four names for one absolute movement, temporalization being the self-othering of the Living Present.
  `derrida-introduction-a-lorigine-de-la-geometrie-commentary#h2-xi` · ¶ 261 · [XI](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/derrida/derrida-introduction-a-lorigine-de-la-geometrie-commentary.html#xi)
  > traditionality (the transmission of sense), temporalization (the self-othering of the Living Present), and historicity are four names for one absolute movement

- **presupposed** · `zeitlichkeit/derrida-intro/009` · *auto-temporalization*
  The radical reduction is said to reach absolute transcendental subjectivity as pure passive-active temporality, the pure auto-temporalization of the Living Present, already intersubjective.
  `derrida-introduction-a-lorigine-de-la-geometrie-commentary#h2-xi` · [XI](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/derrida/derrida-introduction-a-lorigine-de-la-geometrie-commentary.html#xi)
  > *absolute transcendental subjectivity as pure passive-active temporality*, as the *pure auto-temporalization of the Living Present*

- **criticized** · `zeitlichkeit/derrida-intro/010` · *Difference*
  The Living Present is disclosed as non-self-identical at its core, present only in deferring itself without respite, and this is named as the source of the structural delay of reflection.
  `derrida-introduction-a-lorigine-de-la-geometrie-commentary#h2-xi` · [XI](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/derrida/derrida-introduction-a-lorigine-de-la-geometrie-commentary.html#xi)
  > the *impotence to enclose oneself in the innocent indivision of the originary Absolute, because it is Present only in deferring itself without respite* (*en se différant sans relâche*)

- **introduced** · `zeitlichkeit/derrida-intro/011` · *différance*
  The self-differing of the Living Present through retention and protention is identified as différance in all but the later spelling, and Difference is called the opening through which presence is possible.
  `derrida-introduction-a-lorigine-de-la-geometrie-commentary#h2-xi` · [XI](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/derrida/derrida-introduction-a-lorigine-de-la-geometrie-commentary.html#xi)
  > it is "present" only by *differing from itself* — retention and protention (¶235), the going-out-from-self-into-self (¶261), now named as *différance* in all but the later spelling.

*Partial pass: Sections VI and XI, where omnitemporality and the Living Present carry the argument. Sections III, V, VII and X, which also carry term hits, are not extracted.*

### 1963 - Michel Henry, L'essence de la manifestation

`henry-the-essence-of-manifestation-commentary`

- **introduced** · `zeitlichkeit/henry-essence/001` · *temporality*
  Temporality is defined as the act of returning, from the future Dasein projects, onto the being-been of that act, and fear and anxiety are said to be grasped by Heidegger as modes of it.
  `henry-the-essence-of-manifestation-commentary#h2-s-43-situation-and-temporality-the-ontological-heterogeneity-of-their-originary` · § 43 · [§ 43\. Situation and temporality. The ontological heterogeneity of their originary structures and its interpretation in the philosophy of transcendence: the idea of contingency and the fall of Dasein](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/henry/henry-the-essence-of-manifestation-commentary.html#situation-and-temporality-the-ontological-heterogeneity-of-their-originary-structures-and-its-interpretation-in-the-philosophy-of-transcendence-the-idea-of-contingency-and-the-fall-of-dasein)
  > The act of returning (from the future Dasein projects) onto the being-been of this act (that is, of Dasein itself) is *temporality*.

- **presupposed** · `zeitlichkeit/henry-essence/002` · *ekstases*
  The accomplishment of temporality is to be understood not as the simple return of the future onto the past but from the finite horizon of death and from what is delivered to it from birth.
  `henry-the-essence-of-manifestation-commentary#h2-s-43-situation-and-temporality-the-ontological-heterogeneity-of-their-originary` · § 43 · [§ 43\. Situation and temporality. The ontological heterogeneity of their originary structures and its interpretation in the philosophy of transcendence: the idea of contingency and the fall of Dasein](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/henry/henry-the-essence-of-manifestation-commentary.html#situation-and-temporality-the-ontological-heterogeneity-of-their-originary-structures-and-its-interpretation-in-the-philosophy-of-transcendence-the-idea-of-contingency-and-the-fall-of-dasein)
  > The accomplishment of temporality rather must be understood not as the simple return of the future onto the past, but from *the most originary determination* of these ekstases — from the finite horizon of death and from what (relating itself to death) is already (from its birth consequently) delivered to it.

- **revised** · `zeitlichkeit/henry-essence/003` · *situation*
  Situation is said not to coincide with temporality but to take birth in it, arising in the ecstasis of the past because thrownness discovers itself inside that horizon.
  `henry-the-essence-of-manifestation-commentary#h2-s-43-situation-and-temporality-the-ontological-heterogeneity-of-their-originary` · § 43 · [§ 43\. Situation and temporality. The ontological heterogeneity of their originary structures and its interpretation in the philosophy of transcendence: the idea of contingency and the fall of Dasein](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/henry/henry-the-essence-of-manifestation-commentary.html#situation-and-temporality-the-ontological-heterogeneity-of-their-originary-structures-and-its-interpretation-in-the-philosophy-of-transcendence-the-idea-of-contingency-and-the-fall-of-dasein)
  > The situation of Dasein, however, does not confuse itself with temporality; *it takes birth in temporality*.

- **revised** · `zeitlichkeit/henry-essence/004` · *Gewesenheit*
  Having-been is distinguished from the past: it discovers itself in the past, and within that ecstatic horizon it manifests itself as anterior to the opening of the horizon.
  `henry-the-essence-of-manifestation-commentary#h2-s-43-situation-and-temporality-the-ontological-heterogeneity-of-their-originary` · § 43 · [§ 43\. Situation and temporality. The ontological heterogeneity of their originary structures and its interpretation in the philosophy of transcendence: the idea of contingency and the fall of Dasein](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/henry/henry-the-essence-of-manifestation-commentary.html#situation-and-temporality-the-ontological-heterogeneity-of-their-originary-structures-and-its-interpretation-in-the-philosophy-of-transcendence-the-idea-of-contingency-and-the-fall-of-dasein)
  > *Gewesenheit* (having-been) however is not to be confused with the past (*Vergangenheit*); it *discovers itself in the past*.

- **criticized** · `zeitlichkeit/henry-essence/005` · *Gewesenheit*
  What the ecstasis of the past reveals is said to be anterior to the ecstatic opening, so that thrownness is revealed by temporalization rather than produced by it.
  `henry-the-essence-of-manifestation-commentary#h2-s-43-situation-and-temporality-the-ontological-heterogeneity-of-their-originary` · § 43 · [§ 43\. Situation and temporality. The ontological heterogeneity of their originary structures and its interpretation in the philosophy of transcendence: the idea of contingency and the fall of Dasein](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/henry/henry-the-essence-of-manifestation-commentary.html#situation-and-temporality-the-ontological-heterogeneity-of-their-originary-structures-and-its-interpretation-in-the-philosophy-of-transcendence-the-idea-of-contingency-and-the-fall-of-dasein)
  > The *Gewesenheit* (having-been) is *given to* the temporal ekstasis of the past; it is not *produced by* the temporalizing activity.

- **criticized** · `zeitlichkeit/henry-essence/006` · *the already*
