  `marion-sur-le-prisme-metaphysique-de-descartes-commentary#h3-s-14-the-subsistent-temporality-of-the-ego` · pp. 197-202 · [§ 14. The Subsistent Temporality of the Ego](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/marion/marion-sur-le-prisme-metaphysique-de-descartes-commentary.html#the-subsistent-temporality-of-the-ego)
  > For Descartes, being and time converge in a single subsistence.

- **introduced** · `zeitlichkeit/prisme/009` · *the past*
  Because time is defined from the motus cogitationis and present evidence necessarily determines it, the difficulty lies not in reaching present evidence but in acceding to the past.
  `marion-sur-le-prisme-metaphysique-de-descartes-commentary#h3-s-15-the-ego-outside-subsistence` · pp. 203-207 · [§ 15. The Ego Outside Subsistence](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/marion/marion-sur-le-prisme-metaphysique-de-descartes-commentary.html#the-ego-outside-subsistence)
  > if time is defined first according to *cogitatio*, and if present evidence necessarily determines *cogitatio*, then the greatest difficulty consists not in reaching present evidence but in acceding to the *past*

- **revised** · `zeitlichkeit/prisme/010` · *memory*
  It is not the past that makes memory possible but memory that opens the past, by dissolving the present evidence inattention has torn from its effectivity.
  `marion-sur-le-prisme-metaphysique-de-descartes-commentary#h3-s-15-the-ego-outside-subsistence` · pp. 203-207 · [§ 15. The Ego Outside Subsistence](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/marion/marion-sur-le-prisme-metaphysique-de-descartes-commentary.html#the-ego-outside-subsistence)
  > it is not the past that requires and makes possible memory, but memory that, as the dissolution of the present evidence inattention has just torn from its effectivity, *opens* the past

- **introduced** · `zeitlichkeit/prisme/011` · *modality*
  Temporality is verified as the temporality of the being of beings: the present puts effectivity in play as the central category of modality and the past puts possibility in play.
  `marion-sur-le-prisme-metaphysique-de-descartes-commentary#h3-s-15-the-ego-outside-subsistence` · pp. 203-207 · [§ 15. The Ego Outside Subsistence](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/marion/marion-sur-le-prisme-metaphysique-de-descartes-commentary.html#the-ego-outside-subsistence)
  > Temporality is thereby verified as the temporality of the being of beings, since just as the present put effectivity in play as the central category of modality, so the past puts possibility in play and reveals that the present, as presence persevering in subsistence, overflowed from effectivity into necessity.

### 1994 - Rudolf Bernet, La vie du sujet: Recherches sur l'interprétation de Husserl dans la phénoménologie — Commentary

`bernet-la-vie-du-sujet-commentary`

- **introduced** · `zeitlichkeit/bernet/001` · *origin of time*
  The phenomenological question of the origin of time is said to be oriented toward the primitive formations of time-consciousness and to require a bracketing of objective world-time.
  `bernet-la-vie-du-sujet-commentary#h4-i-4` · p. 193 · [I](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/bernet/bernet-la-vie-du-sujet-commentary.html#i-3)
  > the question of the essence of time also leads back to the question of the "origin" of time, but this question of origin is oriented toward the primitive formations of time-consciousness (p. 193)

- **introduced** · `zeitlichkeit/bernet/002` · *Gegenwärtigung*
  Husserl is read as conceding that the present of perception can spill over onto future and past but need not by right, so that presentation founds all time-consciousness and memory and expectation derive from it.
  `bernet-la-vie-du-sujet-commentary#h4-i-4` · p. 195 · [I](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/bernet/bernet-la-vie-du-sujet-commentary.html#i-3)
  > The perceptual experience of the present — presentation (*Gegenwärtigung*) — is the foundation of all time-consciousness; memory and expectation derive from it as acts of re-presentation (*Vergegenwärtigung*) putting to work a doubling of the present. This concession marks a precise fault line: Heidegger will deny that any present can be had without the other two ecstases.

- **presupposed** · `zeitlichkeit/bernet/003` · *retention and protention*
  Retention and protention are distinguished from remembering and expectation as non-independent moments of every intentional act accomplished in the present.
  `bernet-la-vie-du-sujet-commentary#h4-i-4` · p. 195 · [I](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/bernet/bernet-la-vie-du-sujet-commentary.html#i-3)
  > Retention and protention must not be confused with remembering and expectation; they are not autonomous intentional acts but non-independent moments of every intentional act accomplished in the present.

- **revised** · `zeitlichkeit/bernet/004` · *absolute consciousness*
  Absolute consciousness is said not to be temporal, since temporal predicates apply only to immanent temporal objects, and its non-temporality is glossed as an other-temporality.
  `bernet-la-vie-du-sujet-commentary#h4-i-4` · pp. 196-197 · [I](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/bernet/bernet-la-vie-du-sujet-commentary.html#i-3)
  > If temporality is a determination of what is contained in time, then absolute consciousness is not temporal. Husserl clearly assumes the consequence, affirming that temporal predicates such as "now", "before", "successively", "simultaneously" no longer apply to absolute consciousness itself but only to immanent temporal objects such as the intentional lived experiences of perception.

- **criticized** · `zeitlichkeit/bernet/005` · *flux*
  The difference between the temporality of intentional acts and the other-temporality of absolute consciousness is paralleled with Heidegger's difference between derived temporality and originary ecstatic temporality.
  `bernet-la-vie-du-sujet-commentary#h4-i-4` · pp. 196-197 · [I](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/bernet/bernet-la-vie-du-sujet-commentary.html#i-3)
  > The same difference will be found in Heidegger as the difference between the derived temporality of acts of perception and remembering and originary ecstatic temporality.

- **presupposed** · `zeitlichkeit/bernet/006` · *Querintentionalität / Längsintentionalität*
  The present of absolute consciousness is at once retention of the proto-object's past and retention of the elapsed phases of the flux itself, the two named transverse and longitudinal intentionality.
  `bernet-la-vie-du-sujet-commentary#h4-i-4` · p. 198 · [I](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/bernet/bernet-la-vie-du-sujet-commentary.html#i-3)
  > Husserl calls the retention of the proto-object's past duration transverse intentionality (*Querintentionalität*) and the retention of the elapsed flux longitudinal intentionality (*Längsintentionalität*).

- **criticized** · `zeitlichkeit/bernet/007` · *absolute consciousness*
  The consequence Husserl is said to have refused is drawn: if longitudinal intentionality cannot be had without transverse, the flux cannot be absolute, and the founding relation at the heart of originary time is reversible.
  `bernet-la-vie-du-sujet-commentary#h4-i-4` · pp. 199-200 · [I](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/bernet/bernet-la-vie-du-sujet-commentary.html#i-3)
  > As an honest phenomenologist, however, Husserl pays his tribute to the phenomena by installing a reversible founding relation at the very heart of originary time

- **criticized** · `zeitlichkeit/bernet/008` · *time-consciousness*
  Heidegger is charged with passing over Husserl's analyses of absolute time-consciousness in silence, mentioning neither the flux, nor its double intentionality, nor retention.
  `bernet-la-vie-du-sujet-commentary#h4-ii-4` · p. 201 · [II](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/bernet/bernet-la-vie-du-sujet-commentary.html#ii-3)
  > Heidegger purely and simply spirits away the searching analyses Husserl devotes to absolute time-consciousness: neither the flux, nor its double intentionality, nor even the phenomenon of retention is mentioned in a single word.

- **presupposed** · `zeitlichkeit/bernet/009` · *levels of temporalization*
  Heidegger's three levels of temporalization are set out and paralleled with Husserl's, with no Husserlian equivalent found for the third, the temporality of authentic existence.
  `bernet-la-vie-du-sujet-commentary#h4-ii-4` · pp. 201-202 · [II](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/bernet/bernet-la-vie-du-sujet-commentary.html#ii-3)
  > It is not hard to recognize in the first level what Husserl treats as the immanent temporality of intentional acts, nor to parallel the second with the flux of absolute consciousness. It is harder to find in Husserl an equivalent of the third, the temporality of Dasein's authentic existence.

- **introduced** · `zeitlichkeit/bernet/010` · *ekstatisch*
  Temporality is called ecstatic as an impulse tearing what is out of itself, gathering moments that are each already an exit from self into a unity that is itself a wrenching.
  `bernet-la-vie-du-sujet-commentary#h4-ii-4` · p. 203 · [II](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/bernet/bernet-la-vie-du-sujet-commentary.html#ii-3)
  > Temporality is called *ecstatic* because it is an impulse tearing everything that is out of itself, making it be as a movement without respite or rest.

- **introduced** · `zeitlichkeit/bernet/011` · *ecstases*
  The three ecstases are ecstatic in a threefold sense: they do not belong to beings, each loses itself in the other two, and their unity is accomplished in view of one horizon.
  `bernet-la-vie-du-sujet-commentary#h4-ii-4` · p. 203 · [II](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/bernet/bernet-la-vie-du-sujet-commentary.html#ii-3)
  > rather than being the determination of a thing as future, past or present, the ecstases open the horizon permitting a thing to appear as future, past or present

- **presupposed** · `zeitlichkeit/bernet/012` · *Gewärtigen / Behalten / Gegenwärtigen*
  The tripartite ecstatic structure is doubled by the authentic and inauthentic modes, the authentic unity being anticipation, repetition and the moment of vision, the inauthentic being-tensed-toward, retaining and presentifying.
  `bernet-la-vie-du-sujet-commentary#h4-ii-4` · p. 204 · [II](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/bernet/bernet-la-vie-du-sujet-commentary.html#ii-3)
  > the ecstatic unity put to work by the authentic mode has the form of anticipation, repetition and the moment of vision; in the inauthentic mode, ecstatic temporalization is accomplished in the unity of being-tensed-toward (*Gewärtigen*), retaining (*Behalten*) and presentifying (*Gegenwärtigen*)

- **criticized** · `zeitlichkeit/bernet/013` · *vorlaufende Entschlossenheit*
  Making the most originary temporalization depend on anticipatory resoluteness is objected to as resting on a relatively arbitrary and contestable idea of the true sense of human life.
  `bernet-la-vie-du-sujet-commentary#h4-ii-4` · pp. 207-208 · [II](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/bernet/bernet-la-vie-du-sujet-commentary.html#ii-3)
  > It nonetheless seems difficult to deny that in proceeding thus Heidegger makes the understanding of the most originary mode of temporalization depend on a relatively arbitrary and contestable idea he forms of the true sense of human life

- **presupposed** · `zeitlichkeit/bernet/014` · *Innerzeitigkeit*
  Vulgar time is derived from intratemporality, which results from the ecstatic unity of presentifying, being-tensed-toward and retaining, which refers in turn to authentic existence.
  `bernet-la-vie-du-sujet-commentary#h4-ii-4` · pp. 206-207 · [II](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/bernet/bernet-la-vie-du-sujet-commentary.html#ii-3)
  > If vulgar time thus derives from intratemporality, the latter results from the ecstatic unity of presentifying, being-tensed-toward and retaining; and that ecstatic unity, from which inauthentic existence receives its temporal sense, refers in turn to the temporal sense of authentic existence.

- **revised** · `zeitlichkeit/bernet/015` · *Urimpression, retention, protention*
  Primal impression, retention and protention are declared genuine ecstases, temporalizing by going outside themselves and together deploying the horizon in which a temporal object can be given.
  `bernet-la-vie-du-sujet-commentary#h4-iii-4` · p. 210 · [III](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/bernet/bernet-la-vie-du-sujet-commentary.html#iii-3)
  > Primal impression, retention and protention are genuinely ecstases, for they temporalize by going outside themselves, each referring to the others and together deploying the horizon in which a temporal object can be given to be seen as "now", "before", "after".

- **presupposed** · `zeitlichkeit/bernet/016` · *retentional modification*
  The iterative structure of retentional modifications is said to account at once for consciousness of the act's duration and for consciousness of the flux, each retention carrying the inheritance of the whole preceding process.
  `bernet-la-vie-du-sujet-commentary#h4-ii-5` · pp. 230-231 · [II](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/bernet/bernet-la-vie-du-sujet-commentary.html#ii-4)
  > It matters above all to understand that retention is a moment of absolute consciousness, that each new retention modifies all preceding retentions, and that in virtue of the structure of this modification each retention carries in itself the inheritance of the whole preceding process.

- **criticized** · `zeitlichkeit/bernet/017` · *becoming-past*
  Becoming-past is denied to be accumulation or linear pushing-back: the past is continually remodified from the present of retention, and only this permits the experience of duration.
  `bernet-la-vie-du-sujet-commentary#h4-ii-5` · p. 232 · [II](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/bernet/bernet-la-vie-du-sujet-commentary.html#ii-4)
  > The past is continually remodified from the present of retention, and it is only this present modification of the past that permits the experience of temporal duration.

- **revised** · `zeitlichkeit/bernet/018` · *flux*
  Absolute consciousness is said not to have retention but to be retention or primal impression, so that the name flux is only metaphorical and the constitutive regress is arrested there.
  `bernet-la-vie-du-sujet-commentary#h4-ii-5` · p. 233 · [II](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/bernet/bernet-la-vie-du-sujet-commentary.html#ii-4)
  > And inversely, nothing is found in this absolute consciousness: it does not *have* retention, it *is* retention or primal impression.

- **introduced** · `zeitlichkeit/bernet/019` · *Urgegenwart*
  The chapter's positive result is that consciousness gives itself only belatedly, so that the originary present is a present-becoming-past and presence to self stands against a ground of absence.
  `bernet-la-vie-du-sujet-commentary#h4-ii-5` · pp. 235-236 · [II](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/bernet/bernet-la-vie-du-sujet-commentary.html#ii-4)
  > If the time of this self-givenness of absolute consciousness can still be called "present", then it must be said that the "present" is an encounter or difference between "present" and "past" (pp. 235–236). This originary present (*Urgegenwart*) is a "present"-becoming-"past".

*Partial pass: Chapter 1, 'Origin of Time and Originary Time (Husserl and Heidegger)', sections I-III, and section II of chapter 2, 'The Presence of the Past (Husserl)'. `husserl-erfahrung-und-urteil-commentary`

- **presupposed** · `zeitlichkeit/eu/001` · *immanent time*
  Simple apprehension is an egoic activity living within the passive flow of time-consciousness, its object a unity in immanent time enduring through the streaming phases of perception.
  `husserl-erfahrung-und-urteil-commentary#h4-a-perception-as-immanent-temporal-unity-the-still-holding-in-grasp-as-passivity` · § 23 a · [a) Perception as Immanent-Temporal Unity. The Still-Holding-in-Grasp as Passivity in the Activity of Apprehending](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserl-erfahrung-und-urteil-commentary.html#a-perception-as-immanent-temporal-unity-the-still-holding-in-grasp-as-passivity-in-the-activity-of-apprehending)
  > But it is an activity that lives within the passive flow of time-consciousness. The object, as perceived, is a unity in immanent time: it endures through the streaming phases of perception, continuously identified as the same.

- **introduced** · `zeitlichkeit/eu/002` · *noch im Griff*
  The still-holding-in-grasp of what was just given is called a form of passivity within the activity of apprehending, a retentional consciousness that is not an active achievement.
  `husserl-erfahrung-und-urteil-commentary#h4-a-perception-as-immanent-temporal-unity-the-still-holding-in-grasp-as-passivity` · § 23 a · [a) Perception as Immanent-Temporal Unity. The Still-Holding-in-Grasp as Passivity in the Activity of Apprehending](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserl-erfahrung-und-urteil-commentary.html#a-perception-as-immanent-temporal-unity-the-still-holding-in-grasp-as-passivity-in-the-activity-of-apprehending)
  > This still-holding-in-grasp is a form of passivity within the activity of apprehending. The object does not simply vanish when a new phase appears; it is retained in a modified manner, still belonging to the ongoing perception as a just-past phase of the same object.

- **presupposed** · `zeitlichkeit/eu/003` · *horizon of the before and after*
  Every perception is said to have its horizon of the before and after, pointing back to what was previously perceived and presentifiable in memories.

  > Every perception, as consciousness meaning actual objectuality, has its horizon of the before and after.

- **introduced** · `zeitlichkeit/eu/004` · *time-position*
  Everything originally appearing, even in conflict, has its determinate time-position - an immanent phenomenal time and a fixed position in the one objective time.
  `husserl-erfahrung-und-urteil-commentary#h3-s38-the-necessary-connection-of-the-intentional-objects-of-all-perceptions-and-p` · § 38 · [§38. The Necessary Connection of the Intentional Objects of All Perceptions and Positional Presentifications of an Ego and an Ego-Community on the Basis of Time as the Form of Sensibility](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserl-erfahrung-und-urteil-commentary.html#the-necessary-connection-of-the-intentional-objects-of-all-perceptions-and-positional-presentifications-of-an-ego-and-an-ego-community-on-the-basis-of-time-as-the-form-of-sensibility)
  > Hence everything originally appearing, even if it appears in conflict, has its determinate time-position — not only an immanent phenomenal time in the intentional objectuality as such, but also its fixed position in the one objective time.

- **revised** · `zeitlichkeit/eu/005` · *form of sensibility*
  The Kantian thesis that time is the form of sensibility is endorsed as the inner truth: time is the first and fundamental form, the form of all forms and presupposition of all other unity-founding connections.
  `husserl-erfahrung-und-urteil-commentary#h3-s38-the-necessary-connection-of-the-intentional-objects-of-all-perceptions-and-p` · § 38 · [§38. The Necessary Connection of the Intentional Objects of All Perceptions and Positional Presentifications of an Ego and an Ego-Community on the Basis of Time as the Form of Sensibility](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserl-erfahrung-und-urteil-commentary.html#the-necessary-connection-of-the-intentional-objects-of-all-perceptions-and-positional-presentifications-of-an-ego-and-an-ego-community-on-the-basis-of-time-as-the-form-of-sensibility)

- **introduced** · `zeitlichkeit/eu/006` · *form of intuition*
  Temporality as duration, coexistence and succession is the necessary form of all unitarily intuitable objects, and form of intuition carries a second sense of temporal orientation in a presence.

The Necessary Connection of the Intentional Objects of All Perceptions and Positional Presentifications of an Ego and an Ego-Community on the Basis of Time as the Form of Sensibility](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserl-erfahrung-und-urteil-commentary.html#the-necessary-connection-of-the-intentional-objects-of-all-perceptions-and-positional-presentifications-of-an-ego-and-an-ego-community-on-the-basis-of-time-as-the-form-of-sensibility)

- **introduced** · `zeitlichkeit/eu/007` · *objective time*
  In empathy an intersubjectively common objective time is constituted, into which everything individual in experiences and intentional objectualities must be orderable.

The Necessary Connection of the Intentional Objects of All Perceptions and Positional Presentifications of an Ego and an Ego-Community on the Basis of Time as the Form of Sensibility](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserl-erfahrung-und-urteil-commentary.html#the-necessary-connection-of-the-intentional-objects-of-all-perceptions-and-positional-presentifications-of-an-ego-and-an-ego-community-on-the-basis-of-time-as-the-form-of-sensibility)
  > In it, an intersubjectively common objective time is constituted, into which everything individual — in experiences and in intentional objectualities — must be able to be ordered.

- **presupposed** · `zeitlichkeit/eu/008` · *time-connection*
  The time-connection is named as the connection that makes possible the unity of all perceptions and positional presentifications of an ego, established in the sphere of passivity.
  `husserl-erfahrung-und-urteil-commentary#h3-s38-the-necessary-connection-of-the-intentional-objects-of-all-perceptions-and-p` · § 38 · [§38. The Necessary Connection of the Intentional Objects of All Perceptions and Positional Presentifications of an Ego and an Ego-Community on the Basis of Time as the Form of Sensibility](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/husserl/husserl-erfahrung-und-urteil-commentary.html#the-necessary-connection-of-the-intentional-objects-of-all-perceptions-and-positional-presentifications-of-an-ego-and-an-ego-community-on-the-basis-of-time-as-the-form-of-sensibility)

  All experiences of an ego are constituted in the absolute flow of inner time-consciousness, with their absolute position and unique occurrence in the absolute now, whence they retentionally sink.

  The time of the experiences is distinguished from the time of the intentional objectualities: the remembered is past and far removed while the remembering is simultaneous with the perceiving.
